changesApplied.changeMade: Created complete analytics router with 5 REST endpoints implementing aggregation logic for activity execution data
changesApplied.reason: Dashboard UI components (DevelopmentProgressDashboard, LearningView) call /analytics/* endpoints to display activity history. Without this router, all requests return 404, breaking dashboard functionality.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Zero blast radius - new file with no modifications to existing code. Adds read-only aggregation endpoints querying SurrealDB activity_executions table. No side effects on write paths or other components.

changesApplied.changeMade: Added import and export for analytics_router following existing pattern
changesApplied.reason: Make analytics_router importable in app.py for registration. Required to mount endpoints into FastAPI application.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Minimal blast radius - single import line added. No changes to existing imports or exports. Enables app.py to include analytics router.

changesApplied.reason: Mount /analytics/* endpoints into FastAPI application routing. Completes the data flow chain: Dashboard UI → HTTP Request → FastAPI Router → Analytics Endpoints → SurrealDB → Response.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Low blast radius - single line added among 14 other router registrations. No modification to existing routers. Analytics endpoints now accessible at /analytics/* URL prefix.
